versions.content: If no RteEventToTaskMapping is defined for DataRe- ceivedEvent s or SwcModeSwitchEvent s which are responsible for activat- ing RunnableEntity s of NvBlockDescriptor s (see [SWS_Rte_08087] and [SWS_Rte_08088]), the according activities shall be processed in the RTE code is- suing the DataReceivedEvent s or SwcModeSwitchEvent s. For explicit communi- cation this shall be done in the related Rte_Write function and for implicit commu- nication in the task bodies where the preemption buffers are handled. For SwcMod- eSwitchEvent s using asynchronous mode switch procedure, this shall be done in the related Rte_Switch function. Note: For SwcModeSwitchEvent s a direct-call requires an asynchronous mode switch.
